headline: Fort Hays State unbeaten through nine conference matches
dek: Fort Hays State have dropped points only in a draw at Rogers State, and lead Ouachita Baptist by ten points before the two sides meet next. At the other end, Harding have yet to take a point from eight conference matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State's 31 goals are more than Harding and Newman have managed between them.

wire.line: Fort Hays State have conceded seven goals all season and lost only twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's home match against UT Dallas is past its date with no result published, the only such match in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rogers State have had at least seventeen different scorers this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tristan Miller has kept five shutouts for Rogers State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrew Wagenblatt has made 66 saves for Harding and conceded 30 goals.

last_match.line: Northeastern State have now taken points from both meetings with Southern Nazarene this season.

next_match.line: Fort Hays State have yet to lose in conference play and have already won at Ouachita Baptist; Ouachita Baptist arrive on a winning run.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
